text: one cried unto another: Heb. this cried to this | the whole earth if full of his glory
having a live coal: Heb. and in his hand a live coal
he laid it: Heb. caused it to touch
Here am I: Heb. behold me
indeed, but understand not: Or, without ceasing, etc. Heb. hear ye in hearing, etc.
utterly desolate: Heb. desolate with desolation
